meta.title: Polina Zakharova. Coach
meta.description: Make yourself stronger every day. A coach will help you achieve your goals without injuries.

aboutSection.title: Hi. I'm Polina.
aboutSection.p1: I can't imagine my life without mountains, forests, and open spaces.
aboutSection.p2: My journey in sport began back in 2008 with orienteering and rogaining — since then I've seen this world from many different angles.
aboutSection.p3: Over 18 years I've run tens of thousands of kilometers, changed countries, terrains and formats, but stayed true to what matters most — freedom and drive.
aboutSection.p4: Today I'm a coach, I've been doing ski mountaineering for many years, and I help others find their own rhythm and direction.
aboutSection.p5: I build programs that develop not only endurance but self-awareness through movement — being present in your own body, feeling its strength and mind.

individual.title: Individual coaching
individual.description: You choose the format and the goals — I make sure every session delivers maximum effect.

online.title: Online training
online.description: A space for systematic work with no ties to location. I build individual plans that take into account your goal, level, and life context. You decide how much structure and interaction you need right now.

group.title: Group training
group.description: Group training is time where everyone can move at their own pace, but with the energy of a shared goal.

camps.title: Training camps
camps.description: Running camps are more than just training. It's when body and spirit come together. Here everything is simple: we train, walk, recover, and live slower than usual.

business.title: Business offers
business.description: This format is for companies who want to walk the road together toward a shared start line: a trail run, a marathon, an obstacle race, or a charity event.

kyrylo.quote: Polina is a coach who really helps you achieve goals that seemed unreal. This year, thanks to her preparation, I took part in my first mountain trail race, Bukotrail, which I had long hesitated to sign up for. My participation in the Spartan Race obstacle course races also went by more as fun than exhaustion. Polina knows how to organize training so it delivers real results without being a grind. I recommend her to anyone who wants to run effectively and with enjoyment.
kyrylo.name: Kyrylo Psasichniuk

maksym.quote: Training with Polina is the best decision on my running journey! Thanks to her thoughtful approach and well-designed system, we not only improved my physical performance but completely changed my approach to trail running. Polina teaches you to feel your body, distribute your effort wisely over long distances, and, most importantly, enjoy every kilometer. I sincerely recommend her to anyone who dreams of mountains and new summits!
maksym.name: Maksym

about.title: About Polina Zakharova
about.p1: My name is Polina Zakharova, I'm a trail running and ski mountaineering coach based in Kyiv, Ukraine.
about.p2: My journey in sport began back in 2008 with orienteering and rogaining — since then I've seen this world from many different angles. Over 18 years I've run tens of thousands of kilometers, changed countries, terrains, and formats, but stayed true to what matters most — freedom and drive.
about.p3: In recent years I've focused a lot on ski mountaineering and help other amateur athletes find their own rhythm and direction through personalized training plans built around TrainingPeaks.
about.achievements: Achievements: winner of the Chornohora Sky Marathon (Ukraine, 2018, 2019, 2020); overall winner of the "Bojko Trail" 46 km (Ukraine, 2018).
about.mission: Mission: I create programs that develop not only endurance but also self-awareness through movement — being present in your own body, feeling its strength and mind.
about.p4: I work remotely with clients through TrainingPeaks, so the geography of cooperation is unlimited — what matters is a shared language and readiness to train.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: The fastest way to reach me is to message me on Telegram or WhatsApp. I personally reply to messages on business days.
contact.location: I'm based in Kyiv, Ukraine, but I work with clients remotely through TrainingPeaks, so I can coach athletes regardless of where they live.
contact.howToStart: How to get started: write me a few words about your experience and goals — I'll suggest a cooperation format (BASIC, EXPERIENCED, or PRO) and, if needed, schedule an introductory video call.
contact.responseTime: Response time: usually within one business day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This website (zakharova.coach) belongs to Polina Zakharova and is used to present trail running and ski mountaineering coaching services. There are no sign-up or checkout forms on the site, so we don't collect personal data directly through it.
privacy.analytics: Analytics and advertising. The site uses Google Analytics and Google Ads (gtag.js) to analyze traffic and ad performance. These services may set cookies and process anonymized technical data (IP address, device type, page interaction) according to Google's own privacy policy.
privacy.communication: Communication. If you reach out via Telegram, WhatsApp, or email, messages are handled according to those services' own privacy policies (Telegram, WhatsApp/Meta, your email provider) and are not stored on this site.
privacy.trainingData: Training data. If you become my client, your training, health, and target race data are kept in TrainingPeaks — a separate service with its own privacy policy. This site has no access to that data and does not store it.
privacy.calendar: Events calendar. The /calendar page displays a public Google Calendar and does not collect any visitor data.
privacy.rights: Your rights. You can request the deletion of messages or data sent to me personally at any time by writing to polina.zakharova94@gmail.com.
privacy.changes: Policy changes. This page may be updated over time; the last update date is shown at the top.

skiTourList.heroSubtitle: What gear you need to survive 🏔️
skiTourList.question: Still have questions?
skiTourList.answer: Reach out to me during business hours.

torso.title: Upper body
items: base layer (merino wool that wicks moisture is best)

hands.title: Hands
items: super warm mittens for the descent

legs.title: Legs
items: base layer (merino wool that wicks moisture is best)
the last two layers can be replaced with "thin" ski pants
socks — warm knee-high gaiters, 2 pairs. If you have them, bring a thin pair of gaiters too

advanced.title: More advanced gear
items: headlamp (spare batteries or power banks; bring a charger you can use to charge the headlamp)
repair kit: zip ties, a small multitool, reinforced tape (not a full roll, just a couple of meters)
small first aid kit: bandage, plasters (silicone ones are the best), chlorhexidine, painkillers, rehydration salts, isofolia
for those who want it — chemical hand/foot warmers
for those who want it — crampons (this needs a separate discussion)
